verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

xrefs.text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place—
For what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.

verses.text: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.

xrefs.text: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.”
God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!

verses.text: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,

xrefs.text: When you look to the heavens and see the sun and moon and stars— all the host of heaven— do not be enticed to bow down and worship what the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

verses.text: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.

xrefs.text: But I ask, did they not hear? Indeed they did: “Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”
And God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years.
He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
“But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings, and you will go out and leap like calves from the stall.

verses.text: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,

xrefs.text: For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us.
Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.

verses.text: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.

xrefs.text: The sun rises and the sun sets; it hurries back to where it rises.
Thick clouds veil Him so He does not see us as He traverses the vault of heaven.

if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.

verses.text: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.

xrefs.text: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
To impart prudence to the simple and knowledge and discretion to the young,
He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

verses.text: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

xrefs.text: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words became my joy and my heart’s delight. For I bear Your name, O LORD God of Hosts.
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.

xrefs.text: Above all, fear the LORD and serve Him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things He has done for you.
Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

verses.text: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

xrefs.text: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
How much better to acquire wisdom than gold! To gain understanding is more desirable than silver.
Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who acquires understanding,

verses.text: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.

xrefs.text: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
Watch yourselves, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but that you may be fully rewarded.
But the one who looks intently into the perfect law of freedom, and continues to do so— not being a forgetful hearer, but an effective doer— he will be blessed in what he does.
Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the Law.
And without faith it is impossible to please God. For anyone who approaches Him must believe that He exists and that He rewards those who earnestly seek Him.

verses.text: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.

xrefs.text: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
Teach me, and I will be silent. Help me understand how I have erred.
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.

verses.text: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.

xrefs.text: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its desires.
In this hope, I strive always to maintain a clear conscience before God and man.
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

verses.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.

xrefs.text: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
